THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO OR FROM THE UNITED STATES, AUSTRALIA, CANADA, HONG KONG, ISRAEL, JAPAN, NEW ZEALAND, SINGAPORE, SOUTH AFRICA OR ANY OTHER JURISDICTION WHERE SUCH RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION WOULD BE UNLAWFUL.

This announcement is an advertisement for the purposes of Chapter 12 of the Prospectus Rules: Admission to Trading on a Regulated Market (“PRM”) of the UK Financial Conduct Authority (the “FCA”) and is not a prospectus nor an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to subscribe for or to acquire, securities in any jurisdiction, including in or into the United States, Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore or South Africa.

Neither this announcement, nor anything contained herein, nor anything contained in the registration document published by Abenójar Tungsten, S.A. (“Abenójar Tungsten” or the “Company”) on 7 October 2026 (the “Registration Document”) shall form the basis of, or be relied upon in connection with, any offer or commitment whatsoever in any jurisdiction. Investors should not subscribe for or purchase any Shares (as defined herein) referred to in this announcement or the Registration Document except solely on the basis of the information in the price range prospectus approved by the FCA (together with any supplementary prospectus, if relevant, the “Prospectus”), including the risk factors set out therein, which is expected to be published by the Company later today in connection with the proposed offer of Shares and Admission (as defined below). A copy of the Prospectus, once published by Abenójar Tungsten, will be available for inspection at https://abtungsten.es/en/investors/, subject to certain access restrictions.

Following its announcement on 7 October 2026 of its intention to undertake an initial public offering (the “IPO” or the “Offer”), Abenójar Tungsten announces the price range for its planned IPO and its intention to publish the Prospectus, which is expected to take place today.

The Company intends to apply for admission of its ordinary shares (the “Shares”) to listing in the equity shares (commercial companies) category of the Official List of the FCA and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange (together, “Admission”) which is currently expected to occur in late October 2026.
The price range for the Offer has been set at 110p to 140p per Share, implying an estimated market capitalisation at Admission of between approximately £525 million and £628 million.
Pursuant to the Offer, the Company is expected to issue between 103,803,214 and 132,113,181 new Shares to raise approximately £145 million of gross proceeds.

Immediately following Admission, it is expected that approximately 25.4 per cent. of the Shares will be held in public hands (within the meaning of UK Listing Rule 5.5 of the UKLR). It is anticipated that, following completion of the Offer, the Company will be eligible for inclusion in the FTSE UK Index Series.

The Offer will be made to qualified institutional buyers in the United States in reliance on Rule 144A under the US Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”) and to certain other institutional investors outside of the United States in reliance on Regulation S under the Securities Act and in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

The Offer will also be made to retail investors who are resident and physically present in the United Kingdom (the “Retail Offer”) through Retail Book Limited’s (“RetailBook”) partner network of investment platforms, retail brokers and wealth managers, subject to such partners’ participation in the Offer. The Retail Offer is expected to open following publication of the Prospectus and have a minimum application size of £250. The latest time and date for receipt of applications for the Retail Offer is 5.00 p.m. (London time) on 26 October 2026.
the Company has agreed to lock-up arrangements for a period of 180 days following Admission;
each of the Directors has agreed to lock-up arrangements for a period of 365 days following Admission;

Promotora de Minas de Carbón, S.A., the Company’s direct majority shareholder and an entity controlled by the García San Miguel family, has agreed to lock-up arrangements for a period of 365 days following Admission,
in each case, subject to certain exceptions, which will be summarised in further detail in the Prospectus.

Certain existing shareholders that participated in the Company's private financing completed in May 2026 have also entered into lock-up arrangements for a period of six months following Admission, subject to certain exceptions.

It is expected that conditional dealings in the Shares will commence at 8.00 a.m. (London time) on 27 October 2026 and that Admission will become effective and unconditional dealings will commence at 8.00 a.m. (London time) on 30 October 2026.
Further details of the Offer will be set out in the Prospectus, which is expected to be published later today.

The Company has engaged BMO Capital Markets Limited and Peel Hunt LLP as Joint Sponsors, Joint Global Co-ordinators and Joint Bookrunners, Deutsche Bank AG as Joint Global Co-ordinator and Joint Bookrunner, and Canaccord Genuity Limited as Joint Bookrunner in connection with the Offer.
